featured_reviews.name: omkar kale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing customer service at this location. If you visit during 'off-peak' hours (Monday–Thursday, 11 AM – 3 PM), don't expect any attention. The staff seem more interested in their own phones or tracking the stock market than helping customers.
When I showed them a product available on the Croma website, the response was a blunt 'order it online' with zero effort to find an alternative or arrange a store-to-home delivery. There is a palpable sense of judgment here; the staff seems to 'profile' you to see if you’re a serious buyer or just browsing, rather than using 'smart selling' to win a customer over.
In contrast, my experience at Vijay Sales was far superior. Even if their prices were slightly higher, the sales representatives actually took the time to explain pros and cons and look for offers. At this Croma, they’ll show you a product, stand there for two minutes, and then just walk away. If you want enthusiasm or actual service, go elsewhere during office peak hours

featured_reviews.name: Neerajsing Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid at all costs—Service has plummeted and they do not stand by their products.

​I have been a loyal customer here for a long time, but after my recent experience, I will never spend another dime at this establishment. They have clearly lost the "service" in customer service.
​I purchased a set of Sony speakers that had clear, undeniable issues with the bass. When I brought them back to discuss a return or exchange, I was met with extreme defensiveness and blatant rudeness. Rather than investigating the defect, the staff insisted that "the product can never be bad" and essentially called me a liar. Even as we demonstrated the bass issues, they flat-out denied there was a problem.
​It is incredibly disappointing to see a business go from "really good" to "unprofessional and dismissive." I was planning on purchasing an AC and a new phone from them this month, but they have officially lost my business. I honestly don’t understand how this place maintains a 4.7 rating—it certainly doesn't reflect the reality of how they treat their long-term customers now.
​Save yourself the headache and go somewhere that actually respects your patronage.

featured_reviews.name: Driti Wadwa
featured_reviews.review_text: Terrible terrible service from Vijay sales. They delivers a morphy Richard’s air fryer oven with only 3 out of the 10 accessories it was supposed to come with. And their customer service is even worse. They don’t follow through with their calls or actions and their answers are always vague. Don’t even think about buying anything from them. I will be taking this matter up to consumer court as it still hasn’t been resolved.

featured_reviews.name: Niraj Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Vijay Sales. I visited the store expecting professional service and proper guidance before making a purchase, but the entire experience was frustrating from start to finish. The salesmen were completely uninterested in interacting with customers. Instead of helping or explaining products, they behaved as if assisting customers was a burden.

No one properly attended to us, and whenever we asked questions about product features, comparisons, warranty, or pricing, the responses were careless, incomplete, and rude. The staff lacked product knowledge as well as basic communication skills. A customer visiting an electronics store expects detailed information and support before spending hard-earned money, but here it felt like customers were simply being ignored.

What made the experience worse was the attitude of the staff. There was no professionalism, no enthusiasm to help, and no respect towards customers. It honestly felt like unless you were immediately ready to buy something expensive, they had no interest in talking to you. Such behavior creates a very uncomfortable shopping environment.

Vijay Sales may have a big brand name, but customer service at this branch was extremely poor. A good store is remembered not only for products and offers, but for the way customers are treated. Unfortunately, this visit was a complete waste of time and left a very negative impression.

I would strongly suggest management focus on staff training, customer interaction, and service quality. Until then, I would personally prefer shopping from stores where customers are treated respectfully and given proper attention.

featured_reviews.name: Joel Serrao
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a refrigerator from Vijay Sales yesterday and I’m very happy with the overall experience. Mr. Shani Kumar greeted me politely, understood my requirements in detail, and guided me toward the most suitable options with clear explanations and a good deal.

The delivery was completed today smoothly and on time. The team (around 5–6 members) handled everything very carefully, placed the new fridge, and took away the old one without any hassle. Despite carrying it up to the 2nd floor via stairs, they did it very neatly and efficiently.

Overall, a very satisfying experience—the entire team was courteous, enthusiastic, and professional. Would definitely recommend Vijay Sales!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Highly satisfied with the service. Thank you!
